title: Behind the Scents podcast: Telling the story of fragrance
summary: In the fourth episode of the IFRA Behind the Scents Podcast, Jenna Troyli, Co-founder of Noted Communications, explains how the way people discover fragrance is changing – and why telling its story comes with responsibility.

extraction.key_fact: IFRA 팟캐스트에서 Noted Communications 공동 창업자가 사람들이 향을 발견하는 방식의 변화와 향 이야기를 전하는 일의 책임을 설명했다.
extraction.key_fact_quote: explains how the way people discover fragrance is changing – and why telling its story comes with responsibility.
